item.title: The Environment interview reads better on a phone
item.summary: The topic checklist is now the largest text on the screen, the repeated setup copy is gone, and the live transcript no longer cuts a line in half.
item.details: Reopening the interview no longer repeats a detail you already answered in the same session, a spoken range such as "twelve to fourteen hours" is saved as a number, an imperial measurement is converted before it is stored, and temperatures read in the unit system your device reports. Letter grades now follow the A to F scale.
